newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon starts LIG as "buy". [CORRECTED 14:40 MT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon starts LIG as "buy". [CORRECTED 14:40 MT]

text.p: London International Group Plc was rated "buy" when Salomon restarted coverage of the stock in March (corrects from "on Monday"), the investment bank said on Monday.
Salomon set a 12-month price target of 200p on shares in the condom and surgical gloves maker, saying it expected compound growth in earnings per share of 21 percent between 1996 and 2001.
Salomon also restarted coverage of Smith & Nephew Plc, maker of wound dressings, rating the stock as a "hold" and setting a 12-month price target of 190p.
It said the stock was at fair value due to limited near-term news flow regarding its Dermagraft product.
